name: statement_whose_payload_holds_a_lone_surrogate
payload_rule: Input should be a valid string, unable to parse raw data as a unicode string

name: statement_listing_a_refused_record_as_a_subject
payload_rule: an upload the server refused is never a record it accepted or one that conflicted

name: statement_missing_a_stage_never_accepted
payload_rule: stages_never_accepted names exactly the expected stages of each unit that accepted no record

name: statement_with_a_gap_of_a_stage_it_does_not_expect
payload_rule: a run statement's gaps name units of the run and stages it expects only

name: statement_with_an_unanswered_result_of_a_stage_never_accepted
payload_rule: unanswered_results names results of stages that accepted a record only

name: statement_whose_subject_is_not_the_final_record
payload_rule: a run statement's subjects are the record that counts at each unit's latest stage that accepted one, and no other

name: statement_with_a_subject_for_a_unit_that_accepted_no_record
payload_rule: a run statement's subjects are the record that counts at each unit's latest stage that accepted one, and no other

name: statement_with_gaps_out_of_order
payload_rule: refused_uploads names each entry once, sorted by unit, then stage in the order of the lifecycle, then assertion id or digest
